references.text: God created mankind in his image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and hold fast to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.
Then Laban said to him, 'You are my bone and my flesh!' And he stayed with him a month.
And say to Amasa: Are you not my bone and my flesh? May God do so to me and more also if you do not become commander of the army before me forever in place of Joab!
For man was not made from woman, but woman from man. Neither was man created for woman's sake, but woman for man's sake.
"Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and hold fast to his wife, and they shall become one flesh."
For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
Theological parallel: The creation word about 'bone of my bones' forms the basis for understanding Christ's body and the unity of the church.
The Lord's Supper words about 'body' are a direct theological development of the creation word about unity in 2:23.
